- Plywood: ₹65 to ₹120 per square foot. Canon plywood at the lower end, semi-marine plywood mid-range, IS 710 marine plywood at the top. Final rate depends on grade, thickness, brand and quantity.
- Sunmica (decorative laminate): ₹900 to ₹3,500 per sheet, covering both 0.8 mm and 1 mm thicknesses. Acrylic sunmica also stocked.
- Bulk orders for carpenters, contractors and interior designers are quoted at wholesale rates, usually within 24 hours.

## Products

- Waterproof plywood — Canon, semi-marine and IS 710 marine grades, ₹65 to ₹120 per sq ft, for kitchen cabinets, wardrobes and bathroom furniture
- Marine and commercial plywood — IS 710 / IS 303 certified grades
- Sunmica and decorative laminates — 500+ designs in 0.8 mm and 1 mm, plus acrylic sunmica, ₹900 to ₹3,500 per sheet, in wood grain, marble, stone and solid colours
- PVC laminates — water-resistant and termite-proof sheets for kitchen shutters and bathroom vanities
- MDF boards — plain and pre-laminated, for CNC routing, wall panelling and modular furniture
- Tikwood and Salwood timber — seasoned, for door frames, window frames and solid-wood furniture
- Adhesives — Fevicol Heatx (heat-resistant laminate bonding), Fevicol Marine (high-moisture plywood bonding), Super Grip Bond (multi-surface contact adhesive)
- Abro double-sided mounting tape — for mirrors, panels and heavy interior fixtures

## Common questions

- What is the plywood rate in Kandivali West, Mumbai? ₹65 to ₹120 per square foot, depending on whether you choose Canon, semi-marine or IS 710 marine plywood, plus thickness and quantity.
- How much does sunmica cost per sheet? ₹900 to ₹3,500, covering 0.8 mm and 1 mm sheets across 500+ designs, with acrylic sunmica also available.
- Which plywood suits a Mumbai modular kitchen? IS 710 marine or BWR grade waterproof plywood, paired with a heat-resistant adhesive such as Fevicol Heatx for countertop laminates.
- MR vs BWR vs marine plywood? MR (moisture resistant) is for dry interiors such as wardrobes; BWR (boiling water resistant) handles regular moisture and suits kitchens; marine plywood certified to IS 710 has the highest water resistance for constant water contact.
